name: Marrakech-Menara Airport
description: Marrakech-Menara Airport has two terminals housed in one complex. Both terminals have money exchange offices, and there is an ATM in the arrivals hall of Terminal 2. On ATMs, check for the Maestro, Cirrus or Plus logos to be sure that the machine accepts foreign credit cards. Some ATMs work only in French. If your card is taken at the ATM, tell airport security and they can help you get it back.…

name: Les établissements Bouchaïb
price: Check out the prices on the webpage before you go to get and idea of the cost of the items you are interested in
description: Huge two-story store with fixed prices. Carpets, spices, argon oil, jewelry, ceramics, furniture, wood handcrafts, etc.

name: Chez Chegrouni
description: Their vegetarian couscous is supposedly the only true vegetarian couscous in town; it's also bland but they give you plenty of it. Prices go up if you sit on the terrace. Usually packed full of good-time tourists.

name: Chesterfield Pub
description: A slightly unusual experience, apparently an 'English pub' it serves Moroccan lager and has an outside pool in a courtyard with palm trees, not an entirely English experience. Much less touristy than it sounds with a mainly local clientele. It serves a decent pint.

name: Dar Attajmil
description: Centrally located and easy to reach, Dar Attajmil has a sand colored courtyard shaded by a tall banana tree; 4 double rooms with bathroom, 1 family suite with private courtyard, several cozy sitting areas, fireplace and library, a large terrace garden where breakfast and meals are served and a devoted team of 5 lovely persons; hammam, massages, cooking class available. Owner organic farm near Ess…

name: Blablacar Bus
description: A subsidiary of the SNCF, offering routes between Paris and London, Brussels, Amsterdam, Milan, Turin, along with other cities and towns in France.

name: Eiffel Tower
description: No other monument better symbolizes Paris.

name: Tourist office at Plaça de Catalunya
description: This is the main tourist office in the city.

name: Aeri del Port de Barcelona
price: single €11, return €16.50; it's not a part of Barcelona's integrated fare network
description: Have a ride at Port Vell Aerial Tramway. Port Vell Aerial Tramway is the 1450-metre-long harbour aerial tramway with red cars connects

name: Barcelona Eat Local Food Tours
description: A family-owned business that showcases the best of Catalan gastronomy in off-the-beaten districts of Barcelona.

name: Leonardo da Vinci-Fiumicino Airport
description: Rome's main airport is modern, spacious, efficient, and well-connected to the city centre. A lot of carriers fly to this Airport. Also, low-cost carriers have flight to and from FCO Airport, like

name: Castel Romano
description: Near Rome, along the Via Pontina highway. A very large Factory Outlet with more than 100 branded shops. A car is needed to reach the place but a 30% discount in a designer shop is surely worth the 20

name: Camping Tiber
description: On the bank of the river from which it draws its name. To the north of the city. There's a minimarket, a pool, a restaurant and a bar.

name: Istanbul Airport
description: Istanbul's chief airport, and the main port of entry into Turkey, is 30 km northwest of the city in Arnavutköy, on the Europe-side Black Sea coast. It was opened in 2018 / 19 and replaced Atatürk Airport. It has a very wide range of international flights, by Turkish Airlines and other carriers, and domestic flights at least daily to all the major Turkish cities. There's car hire and the usual pas…

name: Suvarnabhumi Airport
description: Space-age Suvarnabhumi Airport started operations in Sep 2006 and is now Bangkok's main airport and one of the busiest airports in Southeast Asia. It is used for international and domestic flights to Bangkok. There is only one terminal building, which covers both domestic and international flights. It is

name: Chulalongkorn University
description: The oldest and most prestigious institute of higher education in Thailand.

name: Chao Phraya Princess
description: Large operator with four modern air-conditioned boats seating up to 250 people. Departure from River City pier.

name: Medina
description: The Medina is the old city quarter located within the sandstone city walls that give Marrakech the nickname the Red City. As an ancient hub, it contains a maze of narrow streets and outdoor marketplaces.

name: Train station
description: For train schedules check out the

name: Chez Monseur Michelin
description: Handmade bags and fashion items made from recycled tires and inner tubes.

name: Chez Yassine
description: Not much choice but served by very friendly people. Tajines and pizzas are great and you can also order skewers that are not on the menu.

name: Le Salama
description: Happy hour from 17:00 until they close, mostly western pop classics on the top floor. Very touristy with shishas, belly dancing and waiters who wear a fez - none of it is typically Moroccan but the overall atmosphere is between relaxed and party vibe. Also offers traditional Moroccan snacks. Good for smaller (up to 10 people) groups.

name: Dar Jaguar
address: 7-8 Derb El Mesfioui, Rahba Kedima, Medina
description: Dar Jaguar is an ancient riad that has been restored as a beautiful private guesthouse. It is situated in the heart of the old medina, neighbouring the exotic Place des Epices (spice market).

name: Flixbus
description: Originally a German company, they serve many routes in and out of Paris, both domestic and international with destinations in Germany, Belgium or even London. Note that although their main hub is Bercy Seine, some buses also go to other places in Paris.

name: Arc de Triomphe de l'Étoile
description: The Arc de Triomphe exudes grandeur and offers a central view of the city.

name: Tibidabo Mountain amusement park
description: Tibidabo is a popular attraction with stunning vistas, an historic amusement park, and the iconic Sagrat Cor church.

name: Cable car
description: Ride the

name: La Boqueria
description: In

name: Comer y no Bombas
description: Shares free vegan food.

name: Ciampino International Airport
description: This small low-cost airport is closer to the city centre than Fiumicino and has no direct train connection. To reach it from Termini and other stations, take a train to Ciampino station, then hop on a bus that goes directly to the airport (Ciampino AirLink). The departure of the bus is linked to the arrival of the train, since the service is offered by Trenitalia through a unique and cheap ticket…
A little further away from Rome than Castel Romano, you can find Valmontone outlet on the motorway towards Napoli just 50

name: Happy Valley
description: It has a pool, a bar, a restaurant and a minimarket.

name: Sabiha Gökçen International Airport
description: Istanbul's Asia-side airport is 30 km east of city centre. It has many domestic flights, often by Anadolu Jet the budget offshoot of Turkish Airlines. Pegasus and other carriers have flights across Europe, the Middle East, North Africa and Western Asia, especially in summer when this is a low cost route to the Turkish beach resorts and Northern Cyprus. None of the airlines that use Sabiha Gökçen…

address: Cumhuriyet Cd 18, Dörtler Apt 7th floor, Elmadağ

name: Don Mueang Airport
description: This was Bangkok's main airport until 2006. These days, the airport primarily caters to budget carriers, and handles flights by

name: National Institute of Development Administration
description: The only university in Thailand that focuses on business education.

name: Loy Nava
description: This dinner cruise heads out with 70-seater rice barges. Departure from Si Phraya pier (near River City), and there is a free pickup from most hotels.

name: Djemaa El-Fna
description: The highlight of any Marrakech night. Musicians, dancers, and story tellers pack this square at the heart of the medina, filling it with a cacophony of drum beats and excited shouts. Scores of stalls sell a wide array of Moroccan fare (see the Eat section) and you will almost certainly be accosted by women wanting to give you a henna tattoo. Amateur boxing matches are sometimes held. Enjoy the va…

name: Supratours Terminal
description: Supratours buses depart from just southwest of the train station (see above).

name: Faissal
description: Tiny workshop making scarves in wool, cotton, and linen.

name: Henna Cafe
description: A pretty little cafe on 3 floors with an orange sign on the Berber hand-carved wooden facade opened in November 2011. You can have a cup of tea or coffee or simple lunch with dessert or just a sandwich. The Henna Café offers safe henna body adornment as well-ranging from a 50 dirham small motif on your hand to a full arm complex design for a wedding from 500 dirham. All profits go to local causes…

name: Hotel Grand Tazi
description: The hotel has a public bar, serving beer and wine and is not overly expensive.

name: Riad Abaka
description: A spacious riad with seven beautifully furnished bedrooms and ensuite bathrooms.

name: Regiojet
address: bus stop along Rue du Faubourg near Château-Landon Metro stop
description: A Czech company, offers connections to Paris from Prague and via Prague from Berlin and other cities. Good service and economical.

name: Champs-Élysées
description: Widely regarded to be one of the most recognizable avenues in the world

name: Artoba Tours
description: City and day tours of Barcelona and Catalonia led by a professional archaeologist.

name: El Glop
description: Three locations, in

name: Estate Romana Festival
description: From late June through early September offers various musical events of jazz, rock, and classical music, and film, sport, theater and children’s fun.

name: Halkalı railway station
description: The current terminus. Ticket machines for the Mamaray trains only accept Turkish cash except for a single one which now takes cards, though it will likely have a long queue when you arrive.

name: Thonburi Train Station
description: The terminus for twice-daily trains to

name: Assumption University
description: Thailand's most prestigious private Catholic university.

name: Manohra
description: These restored Thai rice barges seat 40 people. Departure from Marriott Resort pier, with an optional pick-up from Saphan Taksin BTS station.

name: The Souks
description: Markets of Marrakech, just adjacent to Place Djemaa El-Fna, are where you can buy almost anything, from spices to shoes, jellabas to kaftans, and tea pots to tagines. Undoubtedly, being a foreigner means you will end up paying higher prices than a native would, but be sure to bargain nonetheless. If you happen to run out of dirham, you will also find plenty of people in the souks who will eagerly…

name: Gare Voyageurs
description: CTM operates a separate bus station. You can buy the tickets in advance. The CTM's offices are better than at the Gare Routière, and there are no people trying to push you to their bus company. The office and station on Zerktouni street does not exist anymore. CTM has also an office at the long distance bus station (see above) if you just want to buy your tickets in advance or check the schedule.

name: Maison du Caftan
description: Boutique specializing in traditional Moroccan caftans.

name: Chez Bismilah
description: Amazing food and wonderful service. The owner is very kind and the fantastic chef is a humble lady who cooks perfectly all the traditional Moroccan recipes. Tayine Royale is recommended. The roof top has an amazing view over the old medina.

name: Narwama
description: Restaurant and bar that has a fire fountain in the centre and an open roof around the patio. The atmosphere is very chilled and their food is very good, but slightly expensive. Good for pre-dinner drinks.

name: Riad Amazigh
description: A former luxury riad, now a beautiful hostel. Doubles, singles, and dorms which house up to 8 people. Roof top terrace with nice views, unheated pool, restaurant and bar. Wi-Fi in communal areas, breakfast included. Open 24 hrs, can book activities and excursions.

name: French Open
description: One of the four

name: Notre Dame Cathedral
description: Impressive

name: Spanish Civil War tours
description: Walking tour of Barcelona visiting key sites relating to the Spanish Civil War, covering themes such as Anarchism, the International Brigades, George Orwell and the realities of daily life and bombing during the war.

name: Balordi
description: Located near Plaça d’Espanya. Casual Italian street-food spot specialising in panini and handmade meatballs. Expect bold flavours and quick counter service, with a few sidewalk benches for eating in. Allow about €10–15 per person depending on your choice.

name: White Night (Notte Bianca)
description: In early to mid-September, various events until dawn, plus shops and restaurants, museums stay open while the Roman Notte Bianca stages music, dance and theater events. Expect enormous crowds; buses and trams will be packed to the brim.

name: MegaPass Istanbul
description: MegaPass Istanbul offers several city pass options combining Bosphorus cruises, guided tours, and access to key attractions. Travelers can choose from:

name: Wongwian Yai Train Station
description: Serves the rustic Mae Klong commuter line to the fishing village of

name: Ramkhamhaeng University
description: Thailand's largest public university.

name: Wan Fah
description: These 2-hr dinner cruises include a set meal of farang-friendly Thai food and seafood, live music and Thai classical dancing. Departure from River City.

name: Koutoubia Mosque
description: Named after the booksellers market that used to be located here. It is said that the minaret of the Koutoubia mosque is to Marrakech as the Eiffel Tower is to Paris. The minaret is visible from Gueliz which is connected to the Medina by Avenue Mohammed V. At night, the mosque is beautifully lit. It was completed under the reign of the Berber Almohad Caliph Yaqub al-Mansur (1184 to 1199), and has…

description: Most

name: Café Babouche medina
description: In a small street a few steps from the Jemaa El Fna square. You can eat there in a friendly atmosphere. The veal tagine with prunes and almonds is spectacular.

name: Montecristo
description: Nightclub with rooftop terrace

name: Riad Basma
description: 5 double rooms with bathroom.

name: Stade de France
description: France's national stadium has a capacity of 81,338, and hosts concerts and various events. Soccer clubs sometimes play here when their home stadium is unavailable.

name: Sacré Coeur
description: A church perched on top of the highest point in Paris. Behind the church is the artists' area, in front are spectacular views of the whole city.
